journey.name: contact pay private link pending
journey.description: A saved contact that supports private payments is only paid privately. While the private connection with that contact is still being set up, Pay explains that and opens no payment, instead of paying the contact's public payment details; once both sides have saved each other, Pay works again. Requires two disposable Bitkit identities with contact payment sharing enabled. The second identity publishes public payment endpoints and must not have the first identity saved or linked. The message is a toast, which android layout cannot see: read it from a screenshot taken right after the tap. No payment is sent.

actions.action: On the first device, open Contacts and add the second identity by its Pubky key
Verify the Add Contact notice reads "Please note that you and <name> must add each other as contacts before you can pay each other privately. Payments from this screen are visible publicly."
Save the contact and verify Contact Saved shows the second identity's name
Open the saved contact from Contacts and tap Pay (testTag "ContactPay")

Verify the send amount screen (testTag "send_amount_screen") does not open and a toast titled "Unable To Pay Contact" reads "Bitkit is still setting up a private connection with this contact. Make sure they've added you as a contact too, or ask them to send you a payment request."
Open Send and choose Contact, tap the second identity's row and verify the same toast appears, no amount screen opens and contact selection becomes available again
On the second device, open Contacts, add the first identity by its Pubky key and save it
On the first device, open the saved contact from Contacts and tap Pay (testTag "ContactPay"); if the same toast appears, wait 5 seconds and tap Pay again
Verify the Request or Pay sheet (testTag "RequestOrPaySheet") or the send amount screen (testTag "send_amount_screen") opens, then close it without paying
